scientific.integrity: The universal classification is proved symbolically from the NDB identity. The accompanying computation is a replay of the algebraic reductions, not a finite-search substitute for the proof.
scientific.limitations: Characteristic 2 is excluded; higher-dimensional NDB Lie algebras are not classified; the form quotient is by Lie-algebra automorphisms only.

title: All NDB forms on the affine-line Lie algebra induce only two left-symmetric classes
